title: Zephyr: B.2.1 Small Bounded Queues
description: Implement 4-packet TX queue, 2-per-source forwarding limits with -ENOBUFS error returns.
notes: Verified existing implementation: TX_QUEUE_SIZE is fixed at 4; tx_queue_push returns -ENOBUFS when a full queue cannot preempt; router forwarding default is 2 packets/source and enqueue returns -ENOBUFS at the per-source limit. Host tx_queue test executable passed 22/22 with AppleClang -Wall -Wextra -Werror. routing_fwd_buffer Zephyr tests directly assert the 2/source bound and -ENOBUFS; local qemu_x86 configure was blocked before compilation by the documented Zephyr 4.1/v3.7 module Kconfig dependency loop, not by this code. No source edits needed.
close_reason: Already implemented and validated: bounded TX queue and forwarding backpressure contracts are present; host TX suite 22/22 passed.
